#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;
const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

struct Tuple {
    long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar;
    int numChars;

public:
    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) {
            throw runtime_error("Error reading input");
        }
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        string s = next();
        return stoi(s);
    }

    string next() {
        int c = read();
        while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1) {
            c = read();
        }
        string res;
        do {
            res += (char)c;
            c = read();
        } while (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\t' && c != -1);
        return res;
    }
};

class CGregAndFriends {
public:
    long long mod = MOD;
    long long INF_VAL = INF;
    vector<vector<long long>> nCr;
    
    long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        p *= nCr[a][b];
        p %= mod;
        p *= nCr[c][d];
        p %= mod;
        return p;
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int K = in.nextInt();
        int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        
        nCr = vector<vector<long long>>(100, vector<long long>(100, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i)
                    nCr[i][j] = 1;
                else
                    nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (in.nextInt() == 50)
                cnt1++;
            else
                cnt2++;
        }
        
        vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dist(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, INF)));
        vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, 0)));
        
        dist[0][0][0] = 0;
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        
        queue<Tuple> pq;
        pq.push(Tuple(0, 0, 0, 0));
        
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            Tuple curr = pq.front();
            pq.pop();
            int x = curr.x;
            int y = curr.y;
            int z = curr.z;
            long long d = dist[x][y][z];
            
            if (z == 0) {
                int rem_x = cnt1 - x;
                int rem_y = cnt2 - y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0)
                            continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                            break;
                        if (dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                                dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                                pq.push(Tuple(dist[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1], i + x, j + y, z ^ 1));
                                dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = (dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            } else {
                                dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] = (dp[i + x][j + y][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                int rem_x = x;
                int rem_y = y;
                for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                        if (i + j == 0)
                            continue;
                        if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                            break;
                        if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                            if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                                dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                                pq.push(Tuple(dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1], x - i, y - j, z ^ 1));
                                dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            } else {
                                dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % mod;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF)
            out << -1 << endl;
        else
            out << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;
        out << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    CGregAndFriends solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
